It takes real strength to reach out about this, and I'm glad you did. Feeling depressed all the time and struggling to get through work or daily tasks is genuinely exhausting, and what you're experiencing is worth taking seriously.

A helpful first step is talking with a doctor or a mental health professional—depression is very treatable, and they can help figure out what approaches (therapy, lifestyle changes, or sometimes medication) might work for you. In the meantime, small, gentle steps can help: try to keep a basic routine, get some daylight and movement even briefly, and stay connected to at least one person you trust. Be patient with yourself on the hard days.

If you ever feel like you might harm yourself or can't stay safe, please reach out right away to a crisis line (in the US, call or text 988) or emergency services. You don't have to carry this alone—support is out there, and things can get better.
